representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands create × spatial-workspace with canvas_object and 'placement is intent'; implementation is a 2D zoned plot board: 4 purpose zones + 13 placeable item cards where center-point containment in a zone derives the purpose chip (source/app.js:87-92 zoneOf, app.js:150-154 purposeChipFor). Physical spatiality (many objects, medium density) rendered literally as a floor-plan board visible in both 1280x860 and 1440x900 screenshots.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Canvas workspace dominates ~90% of both viewports; two cards (纸箱×若干, 折叠椅) sit outside zones tagged 未安置, visually inviting the create/place action; 新建 (N) is the first toolbar button (screenshots 1280x860/1440x900; source/index.html:20); status bar states the core rule '落位即意图：物件落入分区 ⇒ 用途自动确定' (app.js:206).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: title + subtitle '落位台 SetPlot · 工作坊开放日 · 平面布置板' (index.html:6,15-16), zone tags carrying name+purpose+count (e.g. 体验区 动手体验 · 5 件, app.js:144), per-item purpose chips, and the bottom-bar rule make the what/where readable in one glance at both viewports; keyboard hints are listed inline in the status bar.

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero structural navigation: single main screen, all 13 objects and 4 zones visible simultaneously with no pan/zoom — canvas auto-fits viewport ('画布总是完整可见，无平移导航', app.js:676-687 fit()); objects reached by direct click or Tab cycle (app.js:503-508, 555-567); screenshots confirm whole board in frame at 1280x860 and 1440x900.

context_loss.evidence: Primary actions are in-place: rename is an inline input inside the item card (app.js:164-179, 463-477), create/drop happens on the canvas with immediate purpose flash (app.js:416-417, 589), undo/redo history preserved (app.js:101-130); the only overlay is the opt-in keyboard reference (index.html:52, task_driven); the bottom status inspector reports live zone/coordinates of the selection (app.js:202-218).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent chrome is 6 toolbar buttons + canvas + one status row (index.html:19-29, index.html:49); advanced operations (align 1-6, distribute d/D, z-order [/]) live in the keyboard layer and the on-demand 键位 overlay (index.html:59-100) instead of permanent panels — surface area proportionate to need in both screenshots.

accessibility.evidence: Checks: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.target_size=pass, a11y.focus_order=skipped (measurement-summary.json). Contrast failure is consistent with visible styling: white 12px zone-tag text on pastel borders (styles.css:147-163 with tones at 165-168, e.g. #7cc793/#7fa5e8) and 11px gray #9b988a kbd/hint text (styles.css:12,40-51,306). Positives: full keyboard operability, :focus-visible outlines (styles.css:53-56), aria-pressed on snap (index.html:26), role=status aria-live footer (index.html:49). Mixed profile → 3.

frontend_rework.evidence: 3 of 7 receipt checks fail (layout.overflow=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail, a11y.contrast=fail; measurement-summary.json) implying styling/typography rework (11px chips/kbd/zone-tag small text, styles.css:49,163,229). Visible defect: 绿植 card purpose chip ellipsized to '动手…' in BOTH 1280x860 and 1440x900 screenshots (70px card, nowrap+ellipsis at styles.css:230-232), so the placement→purpose semantics is not fully readable on that item even though text.truncation=pass.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '空间操作有键盘等价物' is exhaustively covered and advertised: keyboard contract in app.js:492-553 (Tab, Ctrl+A/Z/Y/D, N, Del, Enter, arrows, Alt+arrows, 1-6, d/D, [, ], g, ?) all bound to handlers; help overlay enumerates every operation with its key (index.html:59-100); Alt+arrow intentionally mirrors drag smart-snap semantics (app.js:578-585); toolbar buttons and status bar expose the keys (index.html:20-28, app.js:204).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast=fail — low-contrast candidates visible in source/screenshots: white 12px text on pastel zone tags (styles.css:157-168), 11px #9b988a gray kbd/hint text (styles.css:12,40-51,306)
layout.overflow=fail — not visually locatable in either screenshot (board renders centered and bounded at 1280x860 and 1440x900); failure known only from check id
type.min_projected_size=fail — multiple 11px text surfaces (purpose chips, kbd caps, zone-tag small) below common minimum projected size
绿植 purpose chip truncates to '动手…' at both viewports, leaving the derived-purpose label incomplete on that card despite text.truncation=pass
a11y.focus_order=skipped — no focus-order evidence either way

scores.overall_note: impl-08 is a faithful literal rendering of the cell-j07-s07 brief: a single-screen zoned plot board where dropping a canvas object into a zone derives its purpose label with no form (app.js:87-92,150-154), the primary create/place task dominates the initial screen at both viewports, and the acceptance seed — keyboard equivalents for every spatial operation — is implemented, documented in an on-demand overlay, and advertised in the chrome. Navigation cost and context loss are minimal (no pan/zoom, in-place rename, undo/redo, live status inspector). The weaknesses are finish quality, not concept: three of seven receipt checks fail (layout.overflow, type.min_projected_size, a11y.contrast), the contrast failure matches visible low-contrast pastel zone tags and 11px gray text, the 绿植 card's purpose chip is ellipsized at both viewports, and focus order was skipped so it cannot be credited. Note these are model-judged observations against a frozen rubric, not a human-preference study; task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference remain unobservable here.
